name: The majority voted in favour of a [motion](http://www.openaustralia.org.au/debates/?id=2016-10-20.29.1): > *That so much of the [standing orders](http://www.peo.gov.au/learning/fact-sheets/standing-orders.html) be suspended as would prevent the motion for the [third reading](http://www.peo.gov.au/learning/fact-sheets/making-a-law.html) being moved without delay.* In other words, the majority didn't want to discuss the [bill](http://parlinfo.aph.gov.au/parlInfo/search/display/display.w3p;query=Id:legislation/billhome/r5728) anymore and wanted to [vote on whether to pass it](https://theyvoteforyou.org.au/divisions/representatives/2016-10-20/5) in the House of Representatives immediately.
question: The majority voted in favour of a [motion](http://www.openaustralia.org.au/debates/?id=2016-10-20.29.1): > *That so much of the [standing orders](http://www.peo.gov.au/learning/fact-sheets/standing-orders.html) be suspended as would prevent the motion for the [third reading](http://www.peo.gov.au/learning/fact-sheets/making-a-law.html) being moved without delay.* In other words, the majority didn't want to discuss the [bill](http://parlinfo.aph.gov.au/parlInfo/search/display/display.w3p;query=Id:legislation/billhome/r5728) anymore and wanted to [vote on whether to pass it](https://theyvoteforyou.org.au/divisions/representatives/2016-10-20/5) in the House of Representatives immediately.
